source_title: Our Brand New Food Writing Course

snippets.snippet_text: "It was August 2022 when I was first contacted by the Creative Acquisition Team at Domestika. The email object read: Giulia + DOMESTIKA Collaboration Opportunity... 'Based on what we see in your portfolio, we would love to produce a course in the realm of Food Blogging/ Writing, but we are totally open to your ideas :)' They were asking ME to produce a food writing course."

intake_notes: Substack blog post by julskitchen (Italian food blogger Giulia) published July 12, 2023. Describes receiving an unsolicited outreach email from Domestika's Creative Acquisition Team in August 2022, offering a food writing/blogging course collaboration.
